program:
domain(person,[major]).
% Major does not dress elegantly.
axiom(s1, not(dress_elegantly(major))).
% Major trains regularly.
axiom(s2, trains_regularly(major)).
% Major is not highly educated.
axiom(s3, not(highly_educated(major))).
% Major is a famous figure.
axiom(s4, famous_figure(major)).
% If Major has sympathy for others and is successful, then he supports charity.
axiom(s5, rule([has_sympathy_for_others(major), successful(major)], supports_charity(major))).
% If Major is well-connected, then he is wealthy and an influential person.
axiom(s6, rule([well_connected(major)], and(wealthy(major), influential_person(major)))).
% Major speaks well.
axiom(s7, speaks_well(major)).
% If Major trains regularly and is a formidable opponent, then he can win championships.
axiom(s8, rule([trains_regularly(major), formidable_opponent(major)], win_championships(major))).
% For Major, having wealth and supporting charity are mutually exclusive, but not necessarily exhaustive.
axiom(s9, xor(wealthy(major), supports_charity(major))).
% Major has loyal fans.
axiom(s10, loyal_fans(major)).
% If someone has discipline and natural talent, then they can win championships.
axiom(s11, rule([discipline(X), natural_talent(X)], win_championships(X))).
% Anyone who speaks well or dresses elegantly can have high social status.
axiom(s12, rule([or(speaks_well(X), dress_elegantly(X))], high_social_status(X))).
% If Major has natural talent, then he has high social status and works hard.
axiom(s13, rule([natural_talent(major)], and(high_social_status(major), works_hard(major)))).
% Everyone who is a famous figure is either a respected leader or an influential person (or both).
axiom(s14, rule([famous_figure(X)], or(respected_leader(X), influential_person(X)))).
% Major is not a popular figure.
axiom(s15, not(popular_figure(major))).
% If Major has high social status, then he is either well-connected or highly educated (but not both).
axiom(s16, rule([high_social_status(major)], xor(well_connected(major), highly_educated(major)))).
% If Major wins championships, then he either supports charity or is a popular figure (or both).
axiom(s17, rule([win_championships(major)], or(supports_charity(major), popular_figure(major)))).
% If Major is a skilled boxer, then he is a formidable opponent and has loyal fans.
axiom(s18, rule([skilled_boxer(major)], and(formidable_opponent(major), loyal_fans(major)))).
% Major is not a respected leader.
axiom(s19, not(respected_leader(major))).
